title: Letterhead · Regions
slide_intent: Name the region sending a letter while allowing the organization’s mark to remain its institutional signature. The reader should know which office to contact.
strategic_value: A consistent regional format can identify a regional office while retaining the same writing area and organization-wide letter structure.
demonstration: The Europe example places the regional name level with the international mark at right. A dotted guide connects the name to the left margin of the message.
practical_value: Use the region name in red 10.5 pt Ubuntu Regular. Set the regional address once, retain the accreditation line and omit the director list from this format.

content_islands.name: Regional guidance
content_islands.spec: Set two numbered notes at left about name placement and regional contact details.

content_islands.name: Aligned letterhead
content_islands.spec: Show Europe in an enlarged circle beside the full letter. Run guides across the top mark baseline and down the body margin, then identify the footer with a second marker.
